name: Welcome to Scaretale: Three Past Midnight
source:
The city of Illyrium appeared in England at the end of the 18th century. There were many rumors about it, including those claiming it was a ghost town, or that Illyrium was the embodiment of the Underworld on Earth. Sometimes, strange things really happened there. But be that as it may, Illyrium is just a city that has its own scary and mysterious stories.

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/5-1-0-254]Anivisual[/url]]
translation:
18世纪末，Illyrium城出现在英格兰。关于它有许多传闻，有人说它是鬼城，也有人说Illyrium是人间地狱的化身。有时，那里确实会发生怪事。但无论如何，Illyrium只是拥有自己恐怖神秘故事的城市。

[译自[url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/5-1-0-254]Anivisual[/url]]
